Sentence (English): This dishwasher is a physical hazard with its cheap, poorly designed rack system, rails and rollers.
Comments (English): [ Hazardous Racks - Bad Controls - Poorly Built ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is a physical hazard with its cheap, poorly designed rack system, rails and rollers. We have had this dishwasher almost 5 months and the rail system on the 2nd / middle rack has already broke. There is a gray, plastic clip in the back that keeps the slide rail from falling out. The other day, that gray piece broke off in the back of the dishwasher. When my young daughter was doing dishes and pulled out the middle rack, the entire side of the rack fell down and the dishes almost shattered on the floor. For the moment, I had the wrap the entire back of the rail bracket in tape so that the middle rack will not fall out. The bottom rack is equally haphazard. The design of the rollers is such that if you do not push perfectly in the center of the rack, the rack can slides off and end-up on the floor. Or, if it doesn't slide off, it gets cockeyed and stuck when trying to push it back into the dishwasher. DO NOT LET A CHILD USE THIS DISHWASHER! The poorly designed racks, rollers and rails all too easily allow for the racks to fall out, resulting in shattered dishes and the potential to get hurt. Sadly, this is all besides the fact the layout of the racks makes loading dishes very tricky such that they do not lay on each other. Most recently, the trim around the pocket handle has started to come loose. The pocket handle felt flimsy from the start and we suspect it will fall apart within the next month. The touch-sensitive control at the top rarely respond to a touch. You often need to hit the button multiple times and double-check to see if it actually registered. The only reason for giving this review 2 stars is that the machine is rather quiet when washing. Other than that, the 10 year old, standard GE dishwasher we had before this was significantly better. We will be contacting Bosch for support, and also submitting a CPSC complaint as the rack design should be reviewed for safety. Costco should not be selling these dishwashers.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is VERY VERY quiet.
Comments (English): [ STILL NEW BUT SO FAR ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is VERY VERY quiet. We most impressed by this. We ran and “empty” test cycle on the first day of install (No dishes inside). Button on top are really sensitive, you can push them with a knee (if you have the door partially open) or it seems like just passing it will start them. For example, recently (today) I started the dishwasher by accident due to one of these “accidental touch's”…. I didn't even know it was on and running (that's how quiet it is) until later coming back into the kitchen and I saw all the lights were on and it was running (by the way, no dishes in the unit). Finally on the second day we owned it we started to load it to run its FIRST load of dishes. When pulling out the middle rack, it stuck……I thought maybe the installer didn't take some of the tape or foam they use for shipment off, so I checked inside with a flashlight and couldn't see any issue. Sentence (English): This dishwasher has a well known defect: It has a foul odor because it doesn't pump out the water well at the end of cycle.
Comments (English): [ For the first time, I hate an appliance ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher has a well known defect: It has a foul odor because it doesn't pump out the water well at the end of cycle. Read through the reviews, it's a common problem. If you call the help line, they will tell you to run a sanitize cycle with a bowl full of white vinegar. This is only a one cycle fix. We had a prior dishwasher hooked up and replaced it inline with this Bosch 500. The old dishwasher NEVER had this problem. Until they send this back to the engineers to design a fix, you will probably experience the same problem. It looks nice, when the controls don't get locked up it runs through its cycle and generally cleans the dishes well, but it leaves a god awful egg like smell on the dishes. For this reason, I am entirely repentant for trusting this brand and paying extra for something that was poorly engineered. I'm giving it one star for cleaning because the dirty smell on the dishes make it unusable. Bosch should recall this machine or update the program to have it empty out the hose, or whatever the problem is.

I really like how the center rack is adjustable independently on both sides to allow larger items like big plates on the bottom rack to fit without any clearance issues. The smaller top rack is really convenient for smaller items, and it's adjustable as well. I also like the red lite that shines to the floor on the lower right side when the dishwasher is running. Another feature I like is when the dishwasher is finished through it's cycles , it opens the door automatically to assist drying the dishes. The only thing I can think of that could be improved would be a larger utensil basket fot the bottom rung, which gets a little crowded. On the flip side, the top rack can also fit utensils, so that's not a huge issue.

Sentence (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham.
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Sentence (English): We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married.
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Sentence (English): But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes.
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Sentence (English): I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days.
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Sentence (English): Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher.
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Sentence (English): As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation.
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Sentence (English): One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out.
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Sentence (English): I think that's why people use built-ins a lot.
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Sentence (English): I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person, MDW-601W (White), On-site installation Hello, this is Coupang reviewer Han Dae-ham. We are a newlywed couple in our second year, and we bought almost all of the home appliances except for the dishwasher when we got married. I thought we could do well as newlyweds even if we didn't buy the dishwasher. But it was very difficult to move into the house, have dinner, and wash the dishes. I think a dishwasher is essential for dual-income couples these days. That's how peace can exist in the family. This is a great product that can reduce the possibility of minor disputes. Although it is not built-in, if you live in a slightly older house or do not want separate construction, a 6-person dishwasher would be perfect because the size is not burdensome (I recently heard a review from a friend who is using a 12-person dishwasher. He said that a 2-person household does not use a lot of dishes, but it is too big to run the dishwasher on a 12-person unit and it is a burden and cannot be used properly!) As expected, the installation was very fast because it was Coupang installation. The installer was very kind and came on the desired date and gave a kind and thorough explanation, but the installer was not someone who appeared in the media, but someone who installs all the dishwashers on Coupang! So he told me that the user manual would explain it better than he did and told me to read it carefully. Still, he kindly did a good job of covering the basics. The components include a tray (including cup and spoon trays), an inlet hose, a drain hose, a washing blade, a filter, and a detergent inlet. In my house, the previous owner had already made a hole to use a water purifier, so I connected the inlet hose there and didn't make any more holes! One of the unique things about media dishwashers is that the drain hose has to come out. Since it's for 6 people, the drain hose is clearly visible, which is a bit disappointing in terms of interior design. I think that's why people use built-ins a lot. My new home was all about neatness. There's nothing I can do about it. I think it's a trade-off between effort and neatness. (The drain hose is thicker than I thought and is about 4 meters long, so I can cut it, but the technician said it's better not to cut it.) It can be adjusted in 7 ways! It seems good because you can set it to strong, standard, eco, glass, 90 minutes, fast, and automatic cleaning according to the situation ~ There is also a reservation system so you can run it at the desired time. One thing that is disappointing here is that the program icons are P1~7, so I am not used to it yet, so it is a bit disappointing! There is a detergent inlet inside, and I thought I could put liquid in it, but the user manual recommends putting powdered detergent, so I bought another dishwasher detergent. I was going to buy a dishwasher detergent in powder form, but the technician recommended an alum, so I looked into alum, and since it is for 6 people, I bought a compact 6-person alum dishwasher detergent. Other reviews said it doesn't dissolve well, but the detergent I bought is a foaming detergent, so it washes well without residue! There are also dishes that are not suitable for dishwashers, so please check and use them! (Wood, dishes and spoons that are weak to heat, iron materials that are prone to rust, glassware that is weak to heat, dishes that may discolor, small dishes that may fall off because they do not fit in the tray)! I recommend it! I recommend this to those who really need a dishwasher rather than for interior use, but who don't mind the price and want to use it for 2-3 people. *This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
